item: A Wikidata fetch job that ends in error after the kill switch engaged shows the refusal state, not the raw server sentence (R334)
summary: entitySpineFetch printed job.error raw when the background job ended in error, without the refusal reader the 409 branch and the text fallback use. The job-error branch now goes through _wikidataRefusedByAirplaneMode (text fallback: a job carries no status), so the translated refusal label applies; a quoted phrase or any other job error still renders as an error. The node test fails on the old code and pins the controls.
